Description: Pseudonymous vpcode_hd1 preserved exactly, including leading zeros. String. Shared across paradigms; sharing eligibility is unverified.
Within-participant recording-day index, starting at 0. Distinct days are distinct sessions; actual source dates stay in original_data.

Within-participant experiment-run index, starting at 0; distinct source file/date/start time/subject combinations remain separate. Order uses source start time, with source filename then subject as tie breakers.
Within-participant event identifier; unique together with participant_id.

Zero-based event order within participant. Runs use recording start time; blocks use administered script order. Source record order is retained within blocks and numbered trial order is validated. Blank-number control records retain their source position.
Zero-based timed response-round index within participant. Each run/item is a separate round. Blank for instruction events.
One-based recorded event order within a timed item, including empty/control events. Blank for instruction events.
English paradigm label: ideational_fluency, word_fluency, or expressional_fluency.
English label short or long. Hard tasks are short with task_variant=hard and 120000 ms limit.
base or hard, according to the administered script.
Script time limit in milliseconds. Blank for instruction events.
Original German task cue from the administered IQX script. Original wording and spelling retained; display newline markers converted to newlines. Blank for instruction events.
Unmodified raw recorded string. One entry stays one entry even if it contains several words. Empty string remains empty.
Original latency in milliseconds, including the openended typing/response interval. Blank when unavailable. No exact response timestamp or cumulative time is reconstructed.
typed, empty, or control. Ctrl+B and Ctrl+Q are control records. Empty does not establish timeout.
Path relative to original_data for the unmodified raw source.
One-based CSV record number with header record=1. A quoted multiline record still counts once.
Original trialnum string. Numbering restarts within task blocks; blank instruction values remain blank.
Original Inquisit block label.
Original Inquisit trial label.
English initials from the R-selected scoring file name, normalized to uppercase. No rater averaging performed.
Response string in the scoring source; may differ from the raw response. Never replaces events.response.
Unmodified flu string from the scoring source.
Parsed integer count of scored valid entries, possibly greater than 1. Missing and -99 become blank; unresolved strings stay blank.
numeric, missing, sentinel_missing, or unresolved.
Unmodified rep string from the scoring source.
Parsed integer rep; blank/NA maps to 0 following the R scripts. Unresolved strings stay blank. No new repetition detection.
numeric, missing_as_zero, or unresolved.
1 if scored_response differs exactly from events.response; otherwise 0.
JSON list preserving nonempty unnamed scoring columns by original one-based column_position and unmodified value. Blank when none. Annotation meanings are unverified.
Path relative to original_data of the R-selected scoring source.
One-based CSV record number including header record=1 in that scoring source.
